text.zh: 智能界面的关键问题与限制
text.en: The Key Question and Limit of Intelligent UI

text.zh: 如果“智能界面”意味着让更多人通过自然语言使用软件，重要价值可能在于降低复杂工具的操作门槛，并把模型能力嵌入日常工作流。但这仍只是基于标题的谨慎推断，不能当作原文已经证明的产品方向。
text.en: If “intelligent UI” means letting more people use software through natural language, its potential value could be lowering the barrier to complex tools and embedding model capabilities into everyday workflows. That remains a cautious inference from the title, not a product direction established by the unavailable article.
